texts: Attendance is not only about present or absent.
At every recognition the camera also records the facial expression. Positive, neutral or negative. From that, a mood curve for the whole day is built.
An attention indicator is calculated per lesson. We say this openly: it is not a measurement, it is derived from the mood records. There is no sensor measuring attention.
If anger appears in the label, or several negative records follow one another in a short window, the system raises an aggression flag and writes down the reason.
Is the child under pressure? The system does not diagnose. It only gathers signals: repeated negative mood, involvement in incidents, a sharp break in attendance, more time spent alone.
Those signals go to the class teacher and the school psychologist. The decision always stays with a human.
